# ARAANEX

> ARAANEX is a biodesign wearables brand: anatomy-mapped smart clothing built on biomechanical textile engineering, 3D knitting and sensing fabrics.

ARAANEX's site is a single scroll-driven story about why clothing should be engineered around the human body.

## Sections
- [Our story](https://araanex.com/#section-0): Clothing evolved to protect us. Science will empower it to do more.
- [Evolution](https://araanex.com/#section-1): How clothing's function changed from armour to performance wear.
- [Anatomy](https://araanex.com/#section-2): Pressure, friction and heat across the body's zones.
- [Materials](https://araanex.com/#section-3): The layered fabric architecture: outer matrix, cushioning, compression, moisture channels.
- [Sensing](https://araanex.com/#section-4): Conductive yarn and physiological sensing textiles.
- [Vision](https://araanex.com/#section-5): Research roadmap and clinical partnerships.
